provenance.disclaimer: JapanPad launches are user-created crypto tokens themed around Japanese culture. They are not shares in any company, are not affiliated with or endorsed by any company a creator may reference, and confer no ownership, dividends, voting rights, or claim on any business.

steps.heading: Four steps, one signature
steps.sub: Nothing here is custodial and nothing here is reviewed.

one.title: Pick a theme
one.body: Ten corners of Japanese culture. The theme is a category and a colour — it references no company and carries no price.

two.title: Choose a yardstick
two.body: Optionally measure your market cap against one of {count} Tokyo listings. The price is read live from the exchange feed at the moment you pick.

three.title: Sign the launch
three.body: Your wallet sends one transaction to Pons. JapanPad never touches it, never holds the token, and never takes a cut.

four.title: Trade, then graduate
four.body: The curve prices every buy and sell in {symbol}. At the threshold, Pons moves the liquidity into a permanently locked Uniswap v4 pool.

denomination.heading: Measured in Tokyo, settled in {symbol}
denomination.isBodyOne: A creator can pick one of {count} Tokyo Stock Exchange listings as the unit their market cap is quoted in, the way a chart can be drawn in dollars or in yen. The price comes from a public market-data feed at the moment it is read, and the ticker is recorded in the token’s own description on chain.
denomination.isBodyTwo: Company names and prices are never written into this site’s source. Only the ticker is. If the feed does not answer for a listing, that listing is simply not offered.
denomination.notBacking: Not backing. No company holds anything on a coin's behalf.
denomination.notOwnership: Not ownership. No shares, dividends, or voting rights.
denomination.notRedeemable: Not redeemable. A coin cannot be exchanged for stock.
denomination.notAffiliation: Not affiliation. No listed company is involved with JapanPad.
denomination.notLinked: Not linked in price. The curve trades in {symbol}; the two move apart.

assurances.heading: What this site will not do

custody.title: Never custodial
custody.body: No deposits, no hot wallet, no withdrawal queue. Every transaction is signed in your own wallet and sent to Pons directly.

fees.title: No cut on top
fees.body: Pons charges its launch fee and its trade fee. JapanPad adds nothing, and the creator fee slot points at the creator.

data.title: No invented numbers
data.body: Prices, reserves, progress and fees are read at request time. When a source is down, this site says so instead of guessing.

vetting.title: Nothing is vetted
vetting.body: A theme and a ticker are labels a creator typed. JapanPad curates presentation, not merit — none of this is a recommendation.
